summary: Root cause: NewChirp's own drivers/newchirp_uv17progps_compat.py malformed-tone guard used int(value) not in TONES, so every fractional CTCSS (88.5, 103.5, 141.3, ...) decoded as no tone on all UV17ProGPS subclasses: GM-21, GM-32, UV-17ProGPS, UV-21ProGPS, UV-28Plus, UV-29Pro, UV-32, GM-30 Plus, GM-30 Pro. CPS evidence (CPS_Test.dat): Danbury/Alvin/Santa Fe carry 141.3/103.5/141.3 RX and TX; CPS encodes CTCSS as little-endian tone*10, same as stock. Fixed to compare the decoded tone value; regression test with the reporter's values on three models.
